body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> AERIAL7 presented a new affordable and stylish solution in headphones, the BULLET.
Incredible sound quality in a sleek portable stereo earbud priced for every budget makes the BULLET a must-have for the music-obsessed on the go.
Available in four striking colorways, the BULLET is the perfect fusion in style and audio technology.
